summary: Find help with PongTrace features, permissions and common issues, or contact the developer directly by email.

contact.title: Contact PongTrace Support
contact.body: Email us if you need help, want to share feedback or have a feature request. This address is monitored by the PongTrace developer for product support.

faqs.question: How do I import a video from Photos or Files?
faqs.answer: Open the relevant video analysis feature and choose a video with the Apple system picker. PongTrace processes only the item you select.

faqs.question: Why does PongTrace request Camera or Photos access?
faqs.answer: Camera access is used only for live pose detection and training recording. Add-only Photos access is requested only when you choose to save a result to Photos. You can change permissions in iOS Settings.

faqs.question: Does PongTrace upload my videos or movement data?
faqs.answer: No. The current version requires no account and uses no developer server. Videos, pose landmarks, movement metrics, rally clips and action comparisons are processed on your device.

faqs.question: How do I save, export or delete content?
faqs.answer: Use the available in-app controls to save, export or delete training content. Deleting the app removes its sandboxed data. Copies saved to Photos, Files or another destination must be deleted there separately.

faqs.question: What should I do if a feature is not working?
faqs.answer: First reopen the app, confirm the relevant permissions are enabled and check that your device has enough storage. If the issue continues, contact us at the support email.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.body: Learn how PongTrace handles videos, pose data, permissions and local storage.

contactGuidance.title: Before you contact us
contactGuidance.body: Please include the PongTrace version, iOS version, iPhone model, affected feature and steps to reproduce the issue. Add a screenshot if helpful. Do not send private videos or sensitive personal information unless necessary.
